results.title: Grindr Presents: Madonna LIVE in New York
results.original_title: Grindr Presents: Madonna LIVE in New York
results.overview: Madonna is performing LIVE! Starting off Pride Month by welcoming the community back to the dance floor, and debuting new tracks from Confessions II.  Motha is delivering, and we’re only four days into Pride. Grab your friends, turn up the volume, and join us for a night of music, celebration, and pure queer joy. The dance floor is officially open!

results.title: Five, Six, Seven, Eight
results.overview: Juana's parents are getting a divorce. She doesn't know it, but deep down, she does. Amidst absences and small moments, Juana tries to reclaim the love and lightness of her family life. Which is difficult, because her parents are never together. Most of the times, her father just isn't there. Until he is. "Five, Six, Seven, Eight" is a film about love that, even when it seems to no longer be there, never truly ceases to exist.

results.title: Memoirs from a Dream
results.overview: Based entirely on found footage, the film conveys the story of the Norwegian band Hangface as they move to Los Angeles in the early 2000's to take on the music world with legendary producer Eddie Kramer (Zeppelin, Beatles, Stones). Accompanying them is a mini-DV camera, that 20 years later serves as a portal into the inner lives of five overly ambitious boys who were set on conquering the world.

results.title: Teen Gay Fairytale
results.overview: It's the height of promposal season and everyone at Small Town High School is dying to know which lucky lady will get asked by star lax bro Jax McCauley. But when the school gossips out him as gay, Jax finds himself peer pressured into dating the only other gay kid in school... even though they have nothing in common, and Jax is secretly in love with his best friend, Miller. This coming-of-age satire pokes fun at the way queer characters and romances are typically presented in mainstream media, while also aiming to normalize rather than sensationalize coming out.

results.title: Romin
results.overview: When Romin discovers a lost object in the forest, he asks his friends to help him uncover the legend behind this mysterious object, while a grieving man seeks to use the artifact to bring his wife back.

results.title: Herencia: Los cantos de la tierra
results.original_title: Herencia: Los cantos de la tierra
results.overview: In the hands of the peasant, the countryside becomes a productive space; everything around it bears fruit, not only the land, but also the cultural expressions born from its most intimate experiences, which are expressed through tunes and songs until they turn into celebration.

results.title: Lacuna
results.overview: A young woman revisits an underground party in Athens in hopes of reconnecting with her elusive ex. What she finds out there, however, is a fever dream of her erasure.

results.title: I Don't Speak Italian
results.overview: After hastily moving to Rome for a job interview, a Duolingo-reliant woman must grapple with a hard truth when realizes she can't understand a word of Italian.

results.title: The Daily Photographer
results.overview: Entertaining portrait of Erlend Štaub - a self-made professional photographer working at the president's annual reception, theatrical premieres, and film festivals like Black Nights and Cannes, and talking about life and everything in it.

results.title: Cross My Heart
results.overview: Sharp witted Lydia escapes the drudgery of her nine-to-five by singing at a punk bar with her best girlfriends — that is, until a predatory man targets one of them, and her fury turns to blood-lust.

results.title: My Melody
results.overview: A love triangle between an avid fangirl, her ultimate K-pop idol crush, and her best friend who secretly loves her.

results.title: Get Set Go
results.overview: A wild adventure where one pedal stroke could change everything.

results.title: The LGBTQ+ Films: Q
results.overview: Have you also experienced that your LGBTQ+ allies show support on their own terms? Noah meets his brother to arrange their mother's birthday, but the event takes an unexpected turn when Noah's queerness is brought up in the conversation.

results.title: The Hollywood Blacklist: The Survivors Tell Their Stories
results.original_title: La Liste Noire d'Hollywood: Par ceux qui l'ont vécue
results.overview: Featuring previously unseen footage from an early-1980s Los Angeles party honouring the blacklistees. (Note: this is an expanded version of footage previously used in "La dernière fête des blacklistés", 2025)

results.title: The Nonsense Play
results.overview: In a school obsessed with grades, discipline and obedience, children are measured by results, dreams are dismissed as childish, and individuality is treated as a mistake to be corrected. Amid the absurdity, two students hold on to imagination, emotion and the instinct for freedom; that untimely innocence becomes their quiet way of standing against reality.

results.title: Eh Din Roz Ni Aune
results.overview: In a fortunate encounter, carefree 25-year-old Prabh meets Aavraj, a practical, successful 55-year-old businessman. Their contrasting ideologies create a fun-filled office family drama.

results.title: The Delivery
results.overview: On his final delivery of the day, a courier finds that the address leads to a house that seems long abandoned. But the package carries a specific instruction: deliver in person...

results.title: Me, Myself, and Mary
results.overview: Chris O'Dowd and Aisling Bea star in the viral, true story of Séamas O'Reilly, who got his days mixed up and ended up alone with his boss and the President of Ireland while high on drugs.

results.title: Jonah and Blake in: Dude, We Solved Bullying!
results.original_title: Jonah and Blake in: Dude, We Solved Bullying!
results.overview: Jonah and Blake are back in an all-new adventure! It's the first day of school, and the boys have already made an enemy! Will the two step up and become heroes of the school, or become the laughing stocks of the semester? Meanwhile, dear old dad confronts his new boss... who resembles someone very close to him.
